topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: The rain's been pourin' since dawn, sidewalks glisten like a bad neon sign. Got a message from a client, flowers showed up at her door—no card, no nothing. Says they were roses, red as the lipstick on a dame who ain't lookin' to stay incognito. "What do you make of it?" she asks. Flowers, huh? Could be a sweetheart missin' the mark, could be a stalker makin' his move. Funny how a bouquet can change the game, make the city feel just a little smaller, a little more... crowded. Told her I'd check it out, no promises. People get forgetful, or they do things they can't admit to. I’ll sift through the shadows till I find the truth.
